Packaging and sustainability
Our toys ship in plain recycled cardboard boxes sealed with paper tape. We don't use plastic
air pillows or polystyrene; instead, we cushion parcels with shredded cardboard from our
own warehouse offcuts. Product tags are printed on recycled card and attached with cotton
string. Wherever possible, we buy materials from suppliers in North America to keep
transport distances short.
Who we design for
We design for three groups of animals: dogs of every size and chewing style, cats from
kittenhood onwards, and small pets such as rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and gerbils. We
don't currently make toys for birds, reptiles or fish, because we don't yet have the expertise
to design for them safely.
